description: Search cosmetics and personal care products by name or keyword in Open Beauty Facts. Returns matching beauty products with barcode, name, brand, categories, and image. Useful for finding ingredients and details of shampoos, lotions, makeup, deodorants, and other personal-care items. Example: search_products("shampoo").

page_size.description: Number of results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

name: search_products
title: Search Products
